data.body: HANDOFF STATE 2026-11-12 06:45 PST (session 3d705fec): in_progress, held. Gerrit 3375 (commit 141750acb93) is pushed; make verify exit 0 (05:26-06:44 PST) after fixing the 3 failures the first run found. Blocked: the Bedrock daily spend cap (BedrockDailySpendCapDeny) is attached to the review bot's role (rebar-gerrit-instance-role) and to the lmn production roles, so LLM-Review casts a fail-closed coverage-gap -1 with no code findings. It lifts automatically at 00:00 UTC (16:00 PST). Lifting it early is a spend-policy call, so it is left for the operator. Remaining steps, in order: after 16:00 PST, comment `rerun-llm-review` on 3375 if the vote is still the coverage gap; at LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1 / 0 unresolved, run scripts/gerrit_safe_submit.py 3375 --revision <current sha>; fast-forward the worktree; post completion evidence, tick the AC boxes, and close with `--class preexisting`.
